response.justification: This candidate is fundamentally misaligned with the role requirements. While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering practices and communication skills, he has critical gaps in both mandatory areas: C++ development (only 6 months of experience from 2014-2015, versus the required 5-10 years of active hands-on development) and financial services domain expertise (no fixed income, derivatives, investment banking, or capital markets experience). His entire career trajectory has been in web, mobile, and embedded systems development with no movement toward capital markets or financial systems.
strengths: Demonstrated strong communication abilities through conference talks, workshops, and community-driven open-source projects
Solid software engineering fundamentals with proven CI/CD knowledge, TDD practices, and collaborative development experience
Versatile technical background showing ability to learn multiple programming languages and adapt to different domains
concerns: Critical C++ experience shortage: only 6 months (2014-2015) versus mandatory 5-10 years of active professional C++ development
No financial services, fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise demonstrated across 16-year career
Career focused exclusively on web, mobile, and embedded systems with no evidence of Windows platform or financial systems development
